baselineNativeRun.note: 2.20.97 Auto edit on the user's Sông Congo project, 2026-11-19 08:36. The reason for this release, not a measurement of it.
baselineNativeRun.failure: sameVoiceProjection returned false after the cuts; restore verification reported 'Original marker fields differ.' twice; ok=false, timelineMutated=true.

nativeProbes: Premiere 26.2.2, 2026-11-19, read-only Probe-MarkerRestore.jsx restore-projection on the built sequence (30 fps, 101 A2 clips at speed 1.1): start and end on the frame grid for 101/101 clips; inPoint off the grid for 100/101 clips by up to about 80 ticks; outPoint off by up to about 2 ticks.

Premiere 26.2.2, 2026-11-19, Probe-MarkerRestore.jsx restore-run and restore-journal on the real voice ProjectItem with the host marker tools (tagged markers only, no Save): every case restored exactly, Vietnamese multi-line comments matched character by character, and cleanup left the original 59 markers.
mockEvidence: tests/unit/diagnostic-executor.test.js VOICE_PROJECTION_SPEED_DIVIDED_TICKS_OK: a speed-1.1 mock with tick-rounded source positions entered restoration on 2.20.97 (input delta about -1 tick) and does not after the fix.
VOICE_PROJECTION_TOLERANCE_OK: a half-tick input difference is accepted; input, start or end differences beyond the tolerance still restore; speed stays exact.

changes: sameVoiceProjection accepts start/end within one tick and input within 1/1000 frame; speed, source key and piece count stay exact (#83, closes #82).
The report records voiceProjection (pieces compared, first mismatch, max absolute tick delta per field), and marker restoration errors name the differing fields.
knownLimitations: Acceptance rests on two real projects; the review-marker pre-commit and the voice projection compare (#83) ran on one of them (three runs). Other templates, frame rates and speeds are not yet checked.
Why restore verification reported 'Original marker fields differ.' on 2.20.97 is not reproduced; the error now names the field if it happens again.

Opening a project saved with markers from before 2.20.94 migrates them once: on the Sông Congo saved copy, 19 V1 picture markers moved and end-rewritten (about 14 s). A rerun with current markers writes none (#75).
The review-marker pre-commit rewrites the comments of its 21 markers on every run (about 0.5 s, no moves); cause not investigated.

Six Windows integration groups (installer lifecycle, rollback, panel registry, notification shortcut, native and incident notifications) were not run for this build; no clean-account install test or antivirus scan was recorded.
FFmpeg 8.1.2 source is not attached to the release; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md links to it (user decision 2026-11-15).
